description.value:
ConApt & Apartment, Excellent. A proper bed, a real sofa, appliances that don't spark, a full smart home, space for art and plants. Friends want to come over.

With it in your bedroom, living room and bathroom: +2 to social checks with corpos in a conapt, or with corpos and fixers in a luxury penthouse. +2 to Humanity Gain rolls and the monthly credit.

Bought per room: set the amount to how many rooms you furnish. Rentals come with a basic set; break it and you pay for a new one. A new set arrives and is installed within the month.
